subject: English
passage: In order to develop the first effective vaccine against polio, researchers had to overcome numerous obstacles, including growing the virus in laboratory conditions and ensuring the vaccine's safety for children. ______ it was scientist Jonas Salk who successfully created the breakthrough vaccine that could prevent this devastating disease.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation:
Choice C is the best answer. "Ultimately" logically signals that Salk's creation of the polio vaccine was the conclusion of the process described in the previous sentence, in which researchers working on polio sought to overcome numerous obstacles to develop an effective vaccine.

Why D is incorrect:

Choice D is incorrect because "in addition" illogically signals that Salk's creation of the polio vaccine was merely additional information related to the researchers' work on vaccine development. Instead, Salk's vaccine was the conclusion of the researchers' efforts to overcome obstacles in developing an effective vaccine.
